identity.name: Khwopa Engineering College
identity.short_description: Khwopa Engineering College is a community-based engineering college run by Bhaktapur Municipality, affiliated with Tribhuvan University.
identity.description: Khwopa Engineering College (KhEC) is the first community-based engineering college in Nepal, established in 2008 by Bhaktapur Municipality. It aims to provide quality engineering education at an affordable cost to students from diverse backgrounds. The college is affiliated with Tribhuvan University (TU) and offers undergraduate programs in various engineering disciplines.

academics.academic_calendar: As per Tribhuvan University Institute of Engineering (IOE) calendar
academics.teaching_methodology: Lectures, practicals, tutorials, field visits, and major/minor projects.

programs.eligibility: Passed 10+2 (Science) or Diploma in Engineering with required percentage, and passed IOE Entrance Exam.

programs.name: Bachelor in Computer Engineering
programs.eligibility: Passed 10+2 (Science) or Diploma in Engineering with required percentage, and passed IOE Entrance Exam.

programs.name: Bachelor in Electrical Engineering
programs.eligibility: Passed 10+2 (Science) or Diploma in Engineering with required percentage, and passed IOE Entrance Exam.

programs.name: Bachelor in Architecture

admission.guidance: Admissions are strictly based on the entrance exam conducted by Tribhuvan University, Institute of Engineering (IOE).
requirements: Pass 10+2 Science or equivalent with minimum required marks
application_process: Fill out the IOE entrance form online
Appear for the IOE entrance exam
Apply to Khwopa Engineering College during the admission window based on rank
admission.entrance_details: Centralized entrance examination conducted by IOE, Tribhuvan University.

seo.meta_description: Discover Khwopa Engineering College in Liwali, Bhaktapur. Affiliated with Tribhuvan University, offering civil, computer, electrical engineering, and architecture.

faq.question: Which university is Khwopa Engineering College affiliated with?
faq.answer: Khwopa Engineering College is affiliated with Tribhuvan University (TU).

faq.question: Where is Khwopa Engineering College located?
faq.answer: It is located in Liwali, Bhaktapur Municipality, Nepal.

faq.question: Who runs Khwopa Engineering College?
faq.answer: It is a community-based college fully managed and run by Bhaktapur Municipality.
